snippet.title: First Hero - Epic of Gilgamesh  Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
"First Hero - Epic of Gilgamesh" is an independent third person hack and slash game, based on the adventures of the demigod, collected in the most ancient epic of human memory. Soon  on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379610/First_Hero__Epic_of_Gilgamesh/


more contents on:

Thanks for your support! Any comment or question will be appreciated.
